title_zh: 核对海报方格数量后标出留白

scenario.label_zh: 核算海报方格与打印数量
scenario.goal_zh: 纠正方格总数的计算，确认多张海报的材料数量并约定标出边缘留白

context_zh: 学生奥斯卡与麦准备三张有相同布局的班级展示海报。
author: author-phase08-b

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: There are four columns and three rows, so I wrote seven spaces on each poster.

sentences.speaker: Mai
sentences.text: You need to multiply four by three, not add them. Each poster has twelve spaces.

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: Right. We need multiple copies of the poster, one for each of the three classrooms.

sentences.speaker: Mai
sentences.text: Then twelve spaces on each of three posters means thirty-six small cards altogether.

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: That's logical. I'll count out thirty-six blank cards before we start writing.

sentences.speaker: Mai
sentences.text: Leave a margin around the outside, though. The first layout went right to the edge.

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: Could you use a pencil to mark that? The marker makes a line we can't rub out.

sentences.speaker: Mai
sentences.text: Yes. I'll mark the border in pencil on the first poster, and we can check it before copying the layout.

targets.sense_zh: 页面或版面边缘的留白
